name: Carari
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Attested only by a rediscovered Natterer wordlist (per Glottolog); no grammar or phonology exists.

sources.citation: Biblioteca Digital Curt Nimuendajú (etnolinguistica.org) site search for 'Carari' and the /arawak page (current + the Internet Archive 2019/2023/2025)
sources.note: No Carari items; no downloadable Ramirez PDF.

sources.citation: pt.wikipedia 'Língua cararí' (stub reproducing Natterer's 72-word list as transcribed in Ramirez 2019: 747 / 2020 vol. IV: 250-251) and en.wikipedia 'Cararí language'
sources.note: Nothing on stress; only the wordlist and the note that 72 words were collected by Natterer in 1833 on the Mucuim.

sources.citation: Adelaar, Willem F.H. & Hélène B. Brijnen. 2014. Johann Natterer and the Amazonian languages. Revista Brasileira de Linguística Antropológica 6(2): 333-352. DOI 10.26512/rbla.v6i2.16285
sources.note: Nothing on Carari stress. p. 338: Cararí (river Mucuim) is an unidentified list that 'shows characteristics of an Arawak language, although it seems to lack the usual possessive prefixes'. p. 339-340 warns that Natterer's diacritics are hard to interpret; the acute accent in his Bororo forms marks vowel quality (central vowel), not stress — so accents in the Cararí list cannot be read as stress marks.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page cara1273 'Carari' (classification comment and reference list)
sources.note: Nothing. Comment: attested by a wordlist in the re-discovered Natterer nachlass (Nowotny 1949, Kann 1989, Adelaar & Brijnen 2014); shown by Ramirez 2020: 740-751 to be an independent language, probably Purus subgroup. Six references, all overview/ethnographic/comparative; none typed phonology or grammar.

sources.citation: Adelaar, Willem F.H. & Hélène B. Brijnen. 2026. The Amazonian Language Samples of Johann Natterer (1787-1843). Leiden: Brill.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: Full scholarly edition of all 72 Natterer lists including Cararí, with the editors' reading of Natterer's diacritics; the definitive primary data, though a stress statement is unlikely.

sources.citation: Ramirez, Henri. 2020. Enciclopédia das línguas Arawak: acrescida de seis novas línguas e dois bancos de dados, vol. III (Os outros subgrupos Arawak), ch. 6 'O subgrupo Purus', Carari pp. 740-751; vol. IV Anexo II wordlist pp. 250-251. Curitiba: Editora CRV.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only analytical treatment of Carari (identifies it as an independent Purus language and re-transcribes Natterer's list); if anyone has commented on the accents in the list, it is here. Paid book (R$74,30 per volume at CRV); 2019 preprint withdrawn from etnolinguistica.org.
